title: Splitting a nonnegative correlation
statement: Let $r,s,\rho$ be real numbers with $0\le r\le1$, $0\le s\le1$, and $0\le\rho\le\sqrt{rs}$. Then there exist real numbers $a,b$ such that $0\le a\le\sqrt r$, $0\le b\le\sqrt s$, and $ab=\rho$.
